highlights.title: Why Weibo’s tiny VibeThinker-3B has the AI world arguing over benchmarks again
highlights.description: On Sunday, a team of nine researchers at Sina Weibo — the Chinese social media giant better known for its microblogging platform than for cutting-edge artificial intelligence — quietly posted a 14-page technical report to arXiv that sent shockwaves through the AI research community. Their claim: a language model with just 3 billion parameters can match or exceed the reasoning performance of flagship systems from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek that are hundreds of times larger.

highlights.title: 'A signal of where power sits': Trump and world leaders joined by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google at G7
highlights.description: Frontier AI risks, infrastructure and sovereignty are all expected to be discussed at the world leaders' summit.

highlights.title: AI Leaders Including Altman, Amodei Set to Attend G7
highlights.description: Artificial Intelligence industry leaders including OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei are set to attend the Group of Seven Summit in France on Wednesday. Oliver Crook reports from Evian. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Uber to Offer Robotaxis in Houston With Lucid and Nuro, Posing Challenge to Waymo
highlights.description: Uber Technologies Inc. will offer driverless robotaxi rides in Houston in vehicles developed by Lucid Group Inc. and Nuro Inc., setting it up to challenge Waymo in the fourth-largest US city.

highlights.title: Chinese memory brands ditch Samsung and Micron for homegrown CXMT and YMTC silicon — Corsair, HP, and Dell are already adopting the China-produced DDR5 chips
highlights.description: Chinese memory brands Gloway and KingBank have begun using homemade chips to produce DDR5 memory kits in lieu of Samsung, Micron, or SK hynix DRAM.

highlights.title: U.S. gov't asks court to dismiss NAACP lawsuit against Elon Musk's xAI over use of unpermitted gas turbines — DOJ says Grok model running at Colossus 2 ‘supports mission-critical operations’
highlights.description: The US government is seeking dismissal of a lawsuit from the NAACP, arguing that the Colossus 2 data center is crucial for national security. The data center runs the Grok Gov AI model, and the government claims a shutdown "directly threatens ongoing national security interests."

highlights.title: SpaceX gains 3% after surpassing Amazon in market cap
highlights.description: The space and AI company's stock has surged since its blockbuster IPO on Friday.

highlights.title: Uber will bring its premium robotaxi service to Houston in 2027
highlights.description: This will be the second market to have an Uber robotaxi service outfitted with Lucid EVs equipped with a self-driving system from Nuro.

highlights.title: Uber’s Lucid-powered robotaxis are heading to Houston next
highlights.description: Uber, Nuro, and Lucid have picked Houston as the second city for their planned robotaxi service, with the launch in the Texas city expected in mid-2027.

highlights.title: SSD controller maker Silicon Motion says its consumer PCIe 6.0 roadmap is driven by Nvidia, not by AMD and Intel — RTX Spark agentic AI platform fuels a hunger for storage bandwidth
highlights.description: Nvidia may be ahead of AMD and Intel with PCIe Gen6-supporting platform for client PCs due to its client agentic AI ambitions, and that roadmap has suppliers like Silicon Motion paying attention.

ai.description: HSBC Holdings Plc said it will use Alphabet Inc.’s Google Cloud to roll out artificial intelligence across its global operations, including through projects that can each generate more than $100 million in extra revenue or savings.

ai.title: China Watchdog Urges More IPOs From AI, Hong Kong Listed Firms
ai.description: China’s top securities regulator pledged to welcome more domestic listings from artificial intelligence developers as well as Hong Kong traded firms to bolster onshore capital markets.

ai.title: Brit competition cops order Google to make search rankings less mysterious
ai.description: New rules cover organic rankings, AI Overviews, and user-approved search data sharing

ai.title: China pushes for AI safety as G7 summit wraps up without Beijing
ai.description: China included artificial intelligence in its global governance whitepaper published Wednesday, and said Beijing was speeding up cooperation efforts.

ai.title: BOK Warns AI-Driven Bonus Windfalls May Stoke Broader Inflation
ai.description: South Korea’s artificial intelligence-driven semiconductor boom may wind up complicating the inflation outlook, with the central bank warning that soaring bonuses at major technology firms could fuel broader wage growth and stronger consumer demand.

ai.title: Poland Invests $11 Million in ElevenLabs to Build AI Tech Hub
ai.description: Poland has acquired a stake in artificial intelligence voice company ElevenLabs, as the country hopes to become a major European AI hub.

ai.title: Singapore’s Sea Tests AI Chatbot Migoo in Quiet US Foray
ai.description: Singapore internet leader Sea Ltd. is rolling out a generative-AI chatbot in regions including the US, marking its maiden foray into the highly competitive American consumer market and accelerating its artificial intelligence push.

ai.title: Singapore’s Electronics Exports Jump by Record on AI Demand Boom
ai.description: Singapore’s electronic exports last month rose by the most on record on robust global demand for artificial intelligence-related equipment.

ai.title: General Atlantic in Talks to Lead Round for China’s Kling AI
ai.description: Kuaishou Technology is in discussions with General Atlantic to lead a first round of financing for its video AI arm, seeking to secure a major US backer ahead of an initial public offering.

space.description: Blue Origin is already rebuilding the Florida launch site where its New Glenn rocket exploded last month, making way for the space company to fly again this year and rejuvenate its ambitions to challenge SpaceX.

business.title: SpaceX Heads Toward Fourth Day of Gains Since Record IPO
business.description: SpaceX shares are poised for a fourth straight day of gains, reinforcing the company’s place among the world’s largest after it surpassed Amazon.com Inc. by market value.

business.title: SpaceX Drew $800 Million From Korean Investors on Trading Debut
business.description: South Korean retail investors snapped up almost $800 million of SpaceX shares on the stock’s first day of trading, underscoring strong demand for Elon Musk’s company after local investors were shut out from the world’s largest initial public offering.

business.title: Top Philippine Fintech GCash Owner Wins Approval for Jumbo IPO
business.description: The company behind GCash, the Philippines’ top fintech firm, has secured approval from its board and shareholders for what could be the nation’s largest initial public offering.

robotics.title: The next humanoid robot might not look human at all
robotics.description: The next humanoid robot might not have a head. It might not have legs. It might even sit on a wheeled base and fold down like a deck chair. other.description: Apple recently introduced Personalized Collections in the App Store, which provides users with individually tailored recommendations for new apps they might enjoy. devices.title: Samsung Galaxy XR pre-orders open in UK, available July 8
devices.description: After a limited launch in the US, the Samsung Galaxy XR is now officially coming to the UK, with pre-orders opening today.
